_doc: Format of ONE state in facts.json. Part A: scripts/facts.py. Part B: the agent, after probing. A state has a date and a weight that decreases with age.

A_script.rule: lapsed if lapsed > 0; unused if allotted > 0 and no use in 30 d; low_use if used < 30%; none if no credits

B_agent.note: e.g. the seller said on the last call that leads are not relevant, so the credits lapsed for a reason
B_agent.implication_for_persona: e.g. lead with lead quality, not with unused credits
